Authentic Japanese food, reasonable price
Jun 2018 • Friends
This place didn't look like much on the outside and we just picked it on a whim. We couldn't have left more satisfied. Service was superb - prompt and friendly. An extremely perceptive male server (didn't get his name) particularly impressed us when he popped in at regular intervals to swap out our pots of cold/empty tea for a fresh one. Food was excellent, especially their sashimi- fresh and generously thick slices. We came as a group and were given a private dining room so that we could shoot the breeze for a few hours and never once felt pressured to move along like at those chain restaurants. Would totally visit this place again the next time we're in HCM. Highly recommended! (do note that indoor smoking is allowed in HCM, so try to get a seat at the ground floor instead if you're sensitive to smoke)

You must try the food here! So great !!!
Mar 2017 • Friends
This restaurant makes me so pleased this evening! The vibe here is really warm and natural. It's not too luxurious but very comfortable. You can see how the cook prepares the food in front of you while eating if you choose to sit at the ground, they also have one floor. The food is so amazing with a reasonable price from 50.000 VND to 300.000 VND (2$-13$). I love the Curry Udon here, its flavor is tasty with the curry soup and the udon is so nice, you won't want to miss it. I also tried some sashimi and sushi. The salmon, tuna and horse makerel are very very fresh and amazing when you eat with the wasabii soy sauce. For the roll sushi like Avocado Roll or Salmon Roll covered with a great seaweed sheet, I think you can taste everything better cause it's rolled carefully, they are all perfect to me. I love Avocado Rolls here, they are very tasty! I'm sure that I will come back here again cause the price is not expensive but the food is so so good! And you should make a reservation before coming cause it's kinda crowded especially at weekends.
